name: Zeno Crypto Checkout for MemberPress
author: zenobank

sections.description:
Accept crypto on MemberPress with 0.1% fee

Zeno Crypto Checkout for MemberPress lets your membership site receive crypto and Binance Pay payments directly through on-chain transactions

See exactly what your customers will experience at checkout:
Try the checkout demo

Questions? Check the FAQs
Or reach out through Telegram

External services

This plugin sends order data (amount, currency) to api.zenobank.io to process crypto payments.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Install via the WordPress Plugin Installer or upload manually.
  2. Activate the plugin under Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to dashboard.zenobank.io and create your account.
  4. Add a wallet address (this is where you will receive funds).
  5. In your dashboard, go to Integrations → MemberPress, and click Connect.
  6. Copy the generated API key.
  7. In your WordPress admin, open MemberPress → Settings → Payments, add the Zeno gateway, and paste the API key.
  8. Save changes and start accepting crypto payments for memberships.
